Assign and name your samples

Drag detected samples into Normal or Cancer, or use the type dropdown on each card. Drag between columns to correct a type, or back to Unassigned to exclude a sample. Edit the detected names as needed.

Normal samples are analyzed independently for CNA. Matched somatic calling requires explicit pairing in variant settings. A custom tag also needs a study or control role.

View all study contexts and when to use them (opens in a new tab)

Uses the included evidence catalog. No publication searches or language-model downloads.

ONT methylation with Modkit

Dorado calls modified bases from POD5, or reuses MM/ML calls in your BAMs. Modkit extracts CpG methylation. Select Sturgeon for CNS tumours or MARLIN for leukemias.

Modkit and Sturgeon use CPU. GPU can accelerate POD5 basecalling and MARLIN inference. FASTQs alone do not contain methylation calls.

Or select installed tools and model files below. Blank tool fields use your command search path where supported. Models are required here or in the YAML. Setup records checksums automatically.

Analysis tools and reference

Prepared downloads are reused. About 8.0 GiB for Illumina or 9.7 GiB for ONT, under your project’s reference folder.

Use a local image tag or a registry image reference. The image supplies analysis tools; selected source files, models and annotation databases stay on this computer and are mounted for the run.

1

Specimen and callers

Choose the preservation and the analyses to run.

Preservation: Choose in step 2

Choose Fresh or FFPE from your specimen records.

Variant callers

Matched normals for Strelka2 somatic

Select the normal specimen from the same patient for each tumor. Normal/control group membership alone does not establish a match. The matched normal does not inherit the tumor’s FFPE setting.

How caller results are used

Mutect2 and ClairS-TO produce tumor-only candidates. Strelka2 somatic uses your explicitly matched tumor–normal pairs. Strelka2 germline, FreeBayes, bcftools and Clair3 run independently per sample. Group assignments never create matched pairs automatically.

2

Caller tools and models

Start with Autodetect. Open paths only to review or change them.

Find installed resources

Fill empty paths for the selected callers. Paths you entered are kept.

Simulate resource discovery in fictional /demo folders; your computer is not inspected.

Caller environment

Leave blank to use tools already available to OncoTracer.

Strelka2 environment

Autodetect the separate Strelka2 environment. Docker includes this runtime.

Clair3 model

Check this selection against your sequencing records. Fresh/FFPE does not determine the flow cell or basecaller. The matching model is about 75 MB, downloaded once and reused.

ClairS-TO model

Uses the selected model from the ClairS-TO installation or container. Check the flow cell, basecaller version and sampling rate against your sequencing records.

Use an existing ClairS-TO container (optional)

An alternative to the installed executable. Requires local Apptainer or Singularity.

Target regions (optional)

Choose the BED for your assay and reference build. Target regions are not guessed automatically.

3

Variant filtering

Caller quality filters are applied automatically.

FFPERASE artifact assessment

Existing paths are reused. Public resources are verified and cached in this project's results folder. The FFPERASE runtime still needs to be installed, or use Docker.

Review the FFPERASE license before enabling automatic preparation. The license excludes clinical reporting and requires MSK permission to publish research results. Existing local resources can be supplied below.

FFPERASE source and models

FFPERASE runtime

The standard model assesses whether a variant is present. No YAML file or sample key is needed. Default local false discovery rate: 5%.

Advanced evidence settings

For custom statistical models only. Use the event and sample keys defined inside that YAML.

This is the model's internal sample key, not a patient or barcode identifier.

4

Annotation

Use your local ANNOVAR installation and matching databases.

Installation and database paths

Requires a matching reference build and an unpacked RefSeq TXT / Mrna FASTA pair. Optional ClinVar uses the same build.

If unavailable, calling results are retained and annotation is reported as unavailable. Installation help appears in resource details.
